title: Perturbation probe: tune all knobs with a significance test
question: Can nudging every knob at random in every game, and moving only the knobs whose up and down games differ significantly, find gains that hill climbing cannot see?
change: A new trainer. Each sample nudges all knobs up or down by 25% at random and plays the two opposite variations against each other and against a league; a knob moves half a nudge when its up-versus-down difference reaches z = 3.
method: Tuning run of 100,000 games (10 rounds), against a hill-climbing control of the same budget; final test 400 games
